test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.**

The percentage of employees who called in sick and the number of employees who left their jobs within 2 years (were reflective of the level of job satisfaction).

options.text: are reflective of the level of job satisfaction
is reflective of the level of job satisfaction
has reflected the level of job satisfaction
were reflective on the level of job satisfaction

solution:
The correct answer is 'are reflective of the level of job satisfaction'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• When **two nouns** are connected by the conjunction "**and**," they generally require a** plural verb **form, as both nouns contribute to the subject of the sentence.

 In the given sentence, the two subjects "the percentage of employees" and "the number of employees" are connected by "**and**," forming a compound s
